COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_rcc_rules = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_audit_upgrade_pending }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { always = no }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_pending
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_reward_v3_rcc_rules = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_rcc_rules = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_rcc_rules_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_baath_future = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_credit_source
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_audit_reward_baath_future_instant_0
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit = 1 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_pending
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
	}
}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_baath_future = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_enterprise_accounts_implemented }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_citizenship_implemented }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_party_social_bargain_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0_instruction bonus = 0.3 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_baath_future_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_baath_future_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}

				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_audit_pending_quote_gdp }

COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_reward_v3_bakr_development = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_bakr_development = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_guarantees_implemented
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_deputy_budget_implemented
			}
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					557 = {
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
						free_building_slots = { building = infrastructure size > 0 }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				557 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_development_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_development_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}

COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_audit_upgrade_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_pending
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_bakr_in_office = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_treaty_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = {
				var = treasury
				value = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0_instruction bonus = 0.3 uses = 1 category = CAT_construction }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1_instruction bonus = 0.25 uses = 1 category = CAT_industry }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_bakr_technical_mission_1
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_bakr_technical_mission_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

		}

COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_saddam_industry = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_audit_upgrade_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_credit_source
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_implemented
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit = 1 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_pending
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_reward_v3_saddam_industry = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_saddam_industry = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_leader_saddam_in_office = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_regional_role_implemented }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					557 = {
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
						free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				557 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_saddam_industry_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_saddam_industry_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_audit_pending_quote_gdp }

		}

COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_reward_v3_officer_staff = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_officer_staff = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_merit_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0_instruction cost_reduction = 0.25 uses = 1 category = land_doctrine }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1_credit value = 25.0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				army_experience = 25
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_officer_staff_1
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_officer_staff_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}

	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts = yes

		limit = {

			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 18 }
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_sector_implemented }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					557 = {
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
						free_building_slots = { building = arms_factory size > 0 include_locked = no }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				557 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_state_contracts_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_state_contracts_reward_v3_pending

			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = {
				var = treasury
				value = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_technical_exchange_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_technical_exchange_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }

		modify_treasury_effect = yes

			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_technical_exchange_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_technical_exchange_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_technical_exchange_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				add_tech_bonus = {
					name = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_technical_exchange_0_instruction
					bonus = 0.3
					uses = 1
					category = CAT_construction
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_arab_technical_exchange_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_technical_exchange_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_arab_technical_exchange_reward_v3_pending

		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes

			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_national_question_implemented }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					557 = {
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ

					}
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = {
				var = treasury

				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes

			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {

				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				557 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_icp_industrial_workers_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_icp_industrial_workers_reward_v3_current

		if = {

				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_commercial_courts_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = {
					COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_audit_pending_quote_gdp
				}
			}
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0.005 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
		}
	}

		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			OR = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 2 }
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 }
			}
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_liberal_republic_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = {
				var = treasury
				value = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_commercial_courts_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_commercial_courts_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_commercial_courts_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				decrease_corruption = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_civic_commercial_courts_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_commercial_courts_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}

			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_audit_pending_quote_gdp }

			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_civic_education_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0.005 }

	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_formed
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_constitution_implemented }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					630 = {
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
						free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				630 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_puk_sulaymaniyah_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_puk_sulaymaniyah_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}

		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0_credit = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_credit_source
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_implemented
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0_credit = 0.02 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0_credit min = 0 max = 0.015 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0_credit value = 0.015 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_iip_education_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_audit_pending_quote_gdp }
			}
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0.005 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_iip_education_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
		}
	}

		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_river_talks_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_agri_river_talks_0
		}

			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_audit_pending_quote_gdp }
			}
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0.01 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_agri_river_talks_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
		}
	}

COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_war_reconstruction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_audit_upgrade_pending }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_credit_source
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_implemented
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit = 1 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit min = 0 max = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_current
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_pending
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
	}
}
COLDWAR_IRQ_upgrade_reward_v3_war_reconstruction = {
	COLDWAR_IRQ_refresh_reward_v3_war_reconstruction = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_pending
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_audit_upgrade_pending }
			COLDWAR_IRQ_campaign_active = yes
			OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_accounts_implemented }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reconstruction_need
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_implemented }
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					171 = {
						is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ
						free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = no }
					}
				}
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 1 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0_credit value = 0 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				171 = {
					add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_reconstruction_0
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_current
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_reconstruction_reward_v3_pending
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes
		COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes
	}
}

		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0_credit min = 0 max = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0_credit value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_reward_v3_war_sanctions_response_0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted }
				check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = gdp_total }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_audit_pending_quote_gdp value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
				set_variable = {
					COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_audit_pending_quote_gdp
				}
			}
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_upgrade_invoice = 0.02 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_war_sanctions_response_reward_v3_upgrade_quoted
		}
	}
